list.name: cp_id

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT cp_id FROM cp_status WHERE occurred_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY cp_id

list.label: charger
list.description: Pick a charger that has been active in the last 30 days. The list is bounded by the cp_status partition window — chargers older than that need a longer lookup.

options.content:
## Per-charger drill-down

Production Prometheus metrics deliberately carry **no `cp_id` label** (cardinality blow-up at 1000+ chargers; see `src/eveys_ocpp/metrics/registry.py`). Per-charger panels here read directly from the ClickHouse event tables (`cp_boot`, `cp_status`, `cp_meter`, `tx_started`) that the gateway's Kafka→CH ingestor writes (E2-13, E2-14).

Use this dashboard to drill into a specific charger after the fleet view (01) flagged it. **Last seen** is the cheapest liveness signal — Prometheus's `eveys_ocpp_registry_online_chargers` is fleet-wide, so the per-charger online state is inferred from recent activity rather than a presence ping.

panels.title: Last seen
panels.description: Most recent occurred_at across cp_status / cp_meter for this charger. A green colour means activity in the last 5 min; yellow within the hour; red after.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(occurred_at) AS last_seen FROM (SELECT occurred_at FROM cp_status WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at FROM cp_meter WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id') WHERE occurred_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: Boots in window
panels.description: BootNotification events for this charger in the dashboard time range. Many boots in a tight window = power-cycle storm or firmware loop.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM cp_boot WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND occurred_at >= $__fromTime AND occurred_at <= $__toTime

panels.title: Transactions started
panels.description: StartTransaction count for this charger across the dashboard window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM tx_started WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND occurred_at >= $__fromTime AND occurred_at <= $__toTime

panels.title: Errors in window
panels.description: StatusNotification rows where error_code != 'NoError'. Sustained non-zero = page-worthy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM cp_status WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND error_code != 'NoError' AND occurred_at >= $__fromTime AND occurred_at <= $__toTime

panels.title: Inbound message rate (msg/min)
panels.description: All inbound traffic for this charger: StatusNotifications + MeterValues + BootNotifications, bucketed per minute. Watch for sustained zeros (silent charger) or spikes (chatty charger / loop).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS t, 'status' AS source, count() AS c FROM cp_status WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS t, 'meter' AS source, count() AS c FROM cp_meter WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS t, 'boot' AS source, count() AS c FROM cp_boot WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Error rate (errors/min)
panels.description: StatusNotifications with non-NoError error_code, per minute. Annotated by error_code so a flapping vendor_error pattern is visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS t, error_code, count() AS c FROM cp_status WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND error_code != 'NoError' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t, error_code ORDER BY t

panels.title: Status by connector
panels.description: Each connector's StatusNotification stream — Available / Preparing / Charging / Faulted / Unavailable etc. The whole story of what the charger has been doing in one strip.

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS t, concat('connector_', toString(connector_id)) AS connector, status FROM cp_status WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY t

panels.title: Reconnects (BootNotifications/min)
panels.description: BootNotification rate for this charger. Spikes correlate with power glitches, network instability, or firmware reboot loops. The gateway's idempotency cache de-duplicates retries (E2-11), so each row here is a logical boot, not a retry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS t, count() AS boots FROM cp_boot WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: MeterValues sample rate (samples/min)
panels.description: Charger-reported MeterValues rate. Every transaction-active charger should be reporting — a flat zero during what should be a charging session is a clue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS t, count() AS samples FROM cp_meter WHERE cp_id = '$cp_id' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
